description: List the datasets the current user can read: their own uploads and datasets published publicly. Optional `query` filters by name/description. Each entry gives the dataset id, visibility, kind (spatial, table, samples, raster, document, text or image), the published layer (id, geometry type, feature count, fields), table (id, row count, columns), document (id, title, pages; text files are documents too) raster (id, size, bands) or image (id, size), and the latest version's state.

project.description: A project id (see `projects` in each entry): only that project's datasets.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of the name or description.

scope.description: all: everything you may read; mine: your own; shared: shared with you by others; public: published by anyone.

name: list_datasets
title: List data layers and datasets
